sampling: GU16, Wd32; x/g/u group64 base + per-element S/S2
unit: ceil_log2(sum(shape/sample/W8-limit/input-exponent bounds)) - (W-2); maximum of both output half groups
update: per-K64 signed RNE alignment followed by W-bit addition; error on overflow, no saturation/wrap; fixed base throughout output group
full_trigger: narrow pilot PPL <=1.01x paired state64; trigger allocates full WT2, not an accuracy acceptance criterion
sigmoid: keep original P8-reconstructed-g S8/F3 address; analyze RTL raw-g difference separately
scope: numeric counterfactual only; metadata-derived base generator is software, no hardware scale-service timing or PPA claim
